page.title: Sunset Yoga Cruise in Marbella: Stretch, Breathe, and Sail

data.meta_description: Book a sunset yoga cruise in Marbella: stretch on deck as you sail past Puerto Banús. From €749/2h. Includes skipper, drinks & snacks.

faq.q: Do I need to be an experienced yogi for the sunset yoga cruise in Marbella?
faq.a: No. The session is designed for all levels. The instructor adapts the flow to the group, whether you're a beginner or a regular practitioner. You'll focus on gentle stretches and breathing exercises that complement the movement of the boat.

faq.q: Which boats are used for the sunset yoga cruise?
faq.a: We use the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 guests) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 guests). Both depart from Puerto Banús and have a spacious flybridge or aft deck that's perfect for yoga mats. The skipper ensures a smooth route for stability.

The 2-hour sunset yoga cruise includes the boat, a licensed skipper, fuel, yoga instructor, yoga mats, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. Spanish IVA (21%) is also included – no hidden extras.

faq.q: What time does the sunset yoga cruise depart?
faq.a: Departure times vary with the season. Typically, we set off 90 minutes before sunset, giving you time to anchor at a calm spot, practice your flow, and watch the sun dip below the horizon. We'll confirm the exact time when you book.

faq.q: Can I book a private sunset yoga cruise for a group?
faq.a: Yes, the cruise is private – you and your group have the boat to yourselves. The Astondoa 40 fits up to 9 guests, and the Azimut 39 fits up to 11. Perfect for birthdays, hen parties, or a mindful getaway with friends.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: Your safety is our priority. If the sea conditions are unsafe or the forecast is poor, we'll reschedule your sunset yoga cruise at no extra cost. You can also choose a full refund if you'd prefer.

faq.q: Is there a minimum number of participants?
faq.a: No minimum – you can book solo, as a couple, or with a group. The price is fixed at €749 for the 2-hour cruise, regardless of how many guests join (up to the boat's capacity).

data.body_html:
Imagine the warm Mediterranean breeze on your skin, the gentle sway of the boat, and the sun painting the sky in shades of orange and pink. That's exactly what you get on a sunset yoga cruise in Marbella. This 2-hour experience combines a calming yoga session with a scenic sail from Puerto Banús, giving you a unique way to unwind after a day in the sun. Whether you're a seasoned yogi or a complete beginner, this cruise is designed to help you stretch, breathe, and let go – all while taking in the stunning Costa del Sol coastline.

Why Choose a Sunset Yoga Cruise in Marbella?

Marbella is famous for its glamorous marina, golden beaches, and lively nightlife, but it's also the perfect place to slow down. A sunset yoga cruise offers a rare chance to disconnect from the hustle and bustle and reconnect with yourself. The combination of gentle movement, deep breathing, and the soothing sound of the sea creates a mindfulness experience you simply can't replicate on land. Plus, you get to see Marbella from a completely different perspective – from the water, with the iconic La Concha mountain as your backdrop.

What to Expect on Your Cruise

Your journey begins at Puerto Banús, where you'll board either the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 guests) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 guests). Both boats have spacious decks that provide plenty of room for yoga mats. As we cruise along the coast, your instructor will lead you through a gentle vinyasa flow, focusing on poses that are safe and comfortable on a moving boat. After the session, you can relax with a glass of cava or a soft drink while watching the sunset over the Mediterranean.

Our Boats for the Yoga Cruise

We've selected two boats that are ideal for this experience:

  • Astondoa 40 – 12.5m, up to 9 guests, flybridge for panoramic views.
  • Azimut 39 – 12.5m, up to 11 guests, spacious aft deck for your yoga session.

Both depart from Puerto Banús and are equipped with all safety gear, comfortable seating, and a table for snacks and drinks. The skipper will find a calm anchorage spot, so you can focus on your practice without worrying about waves.

Pricing and Inclusions

The sunset yoga cruise is priced at €749 for 2 hours, which includes everything you need for a perfect evening. If you want to extend the experience, you can upgrade to an 8-hour charter for €2,299, ideal for a full day of sailing with yoga at sunset. Here's what's included:

  • Licensed skipper and fuel
  • Yoga instructor and yoga mats
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden costs

Best Time to Book

The sunset yoga cruise runs from April to October, when the evenings are warm and the sunsets are spectacular. The best months are June, July, and August, when the sun sets around 21:30 – giving you plenty of daylight for a pre-cruise swim or a post-yoga dip. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during peak season, as spots fill up quickly.

What to Bring

We provide the yoga mats, but you should bring:

  • Comfortable clothing that you can move in
  • A light jacket or sweater for the evening breeze
  • Sunscreen (even in the late afternoon, the sun can be strong)
  • A water bottle (though we also provide water)
  • Your camera for that perfect sunset shot

How to Book Your Sunset Yoga Cruise

Ready to stretch and sail? Booking is simple. Head over to our Boat Rental Marbella homepage to see all available options, or contact us on WhatsApp for a personalised quote. You can also explore other experiences like sunset cruises or private charters to find the perfect fit for your group. For a full day on the water, check out our day charter options.

No. The session is designed for all levels. The instructor adapts the flow to the group, whether you're a beginner or a regular practitioner. You'll focus on gentle stretches and breathing exercises that complement the movement of the boat.

The 2-hour sunset yoga cruise includes the boat, a licensed skipper, fuel, yoga instructor, yoga mats, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. Spanish IVA (21%) is also included – no hidden extras.

What time does the sunset yoga cruise depart?

Departure times vary with the season. Typically, we set off 90 minutes before sunset, giving you time to anchor at a calm spot, practice your flow, and watch the sun dip below the horizon. We'll confirm the exact time when you book.

Yes, the cruise is private – you and your group have the boat to yourselves. The Astondoa 40 fits up to 9 guests, and the Azimut 39 fits up to 11. Perfect for birthdays, hen parties, or a mindful getaway with friends.
